thread:
Priya: kicking off a short sync on recurring KV-cache eviction incidents. noticed these keep popping up after traffic spikes. quick take pls: top cause you see and any open blockers. agenda: signatures, ownership gaps, short fixes.

Sam: seeing evictions u200-500/s during sustained bursts. primary pattern: shard hotness + cache TTL variability.

Rob: agree. also saw some fragmentation after the recent shard-remap deploy. might be related to in-flight connections.

Nina: tracker link: #412 (kv-eviction-mitigation). current blockers: mem tuning changes need QA signoff, and a small infra migration dependent on infra-ops.

Priya: can we get a 1-liner mitigation per person? short-lived; want to capture actions.

Sam: short mitigation: bump per-shard cache limit by 20% for hot keys (owner: Sam, ETA: 2026-04-06).

Rob: short mitigation: revert shard-remap flags if we see >2x eviction rate post-deploy (owner: Rob, ETA: immediate on deploy).

Nina: blocker follow-up: infra migration ETA now 2026-04-08, waiting on ops slot. adding accept criteria to #412.

Priya: nice. incident-bot run for March window?

incident-bot: summary for 2026-03-01..2026-03-31: 19 incidents tagged "kv-eviction". median MTTR 15m. top cause labels: shard-hotness (47%), config-regression (21%), pressure-after-deploy (18%).

Sam: propose an automated circuit-breaker: if evictions >200/s for 2m then throttle non-critical background traffic. simple rule.

Rob: can we add a CI test that simulates shard remap + load? if we catch fragmentation regressions pre-deploy it's huge. happy to pair on this.

Nina: adding two more actions to tracker:

```
- Action 1: Implement circuit-breaker throttling for background tasks (owner: Sam, ETA: 2026-04-14)
- Action 2: Add CI shard-remap stress test (owner: Rob, ETA: 2026-04-10)
- Action 3: Infra migration slot booking (owner: Nina, ETA: 2026-04-08)
```

Priya: ownership gap: who owns long-term cache-policy work? we need a single owner to avoid conflicting fixes.

Sam: volunteer to own cache-policy roadmap but need 20% allocation for the quarter.

Rob: +1 to Sam owning it. will defer config PR reviews to him.

Priya: great. last ask: please add a 1-sentence update to #412 by EOD Monday. i'll run a small retro next Wednesday to see if recurrence drops.

Nina: done. setting weekly digest for owners.

Sam: will draft throttling design and PR by 2026-04-07.

Rob: pairing with Sam on CI test, will spike tomorrow.

incident-bot: follow-up reminder set: owners to update #412 by 2026-04-06.

Priya: thanks everyone. quick note: if you see a thawing evictions pattern in prod, ping here asap and tag incident-bot to get a digest. :thumbsup:
